I have a container with a volume of 2.5 m^3 and I am able to maintain the temperature at 300 Kelvin. I will be repeating the experiment at a higher temperature of 350 Kelvin and then at a lower volume of 1.5 m^3. I am using air for all these experiments. Can you provide the heat capacity for these three different conditions?"
